q: What will a steel mill abroad ask an Indian ferromanganese supplier for?
title: Indian ferromanganese: data for steel mills
short: The specific embedded emissions of your ferromanganese, in tonnes CO2 per tonne, for the latest calendar year, with how it was measured. A steel mill exporting to the EU counts your alloy as a precursor, so your figure replaces a default value in its own CBAM report.
audience: Ferromanganese makers in India supplying steel mills in Turkey, Vietnam, the Middle East and elsewhere that export to the EU

ul: Direct embedded emissions per tonne, from the reductant mass balance plus fuel used inside the installation.
Electricity per tonne, reported but not charged for steel goods.
Production route, reporting period and whether the figure is verified.

p: Ferromanganese under CN 7202 11 and 7202 19 is a relevant precursor for steel. Without your data, the steel mill must use a default value with a mark up, which makes its steel more expensive for the EU buyer.
One figure per product grade and period, in the units the CBAM template uses, beats a long report. Keep the workings ready for their verifier.
